serialize_field: create a function that serializes dataclass, Enum, list, and dict field values to JSON-compatible format
make_serializable: build a utility that converts dataclasses, Enums, and complex objects into JSON or Pickle compatible formats
EnumEncoder: create a custom JSON encoder class that serializes Enum instances using their value attribute
SkippableDeepCopy: build a base class that skips specified fields during deepcopy and pickle operations for non-serializable attributes
review_serialization_utils: review the serialization module to understand how serialize_field and make_serializable handle dataclass and Enum conversion
